capabilities: Add a new line above the current line without moving the cursor
Add a new line after the current line without moving the cursor
Duplicate the current line or selection via hotkey
extras: Default keybindings are given in macOS terms (Command, Option); Windows/Linux equivalents are not documented.
problem: Obsidian lacks built-in keybindings for adding lines above or below the cursor without moving to the line end, and for duplicating lines or selections.
summary: Editor hotkey plugin that adds line manipulation commands for inserting new lines and duplicating lines or selections.
